summary_en: Dividend per share raised by 2 yen to 59 yen for fiscal year ending September 2026, reflecting 10 consecutive years of revenue and profit growth and results exceeding initial plan.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase) and Variance from Prior Period Individual Results
translation_en_brief:
Shinnihonseiyaku has revised its dividend forecast upward by 2 yen per share to 59 yen for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. The increase reflects the company's strong operating performance, which exceeded initial expectations. The company reported net profit of 3.3 billion yen, a 40.1% increase from the prior year, driven by efficient advertising investment allocation focused on ROI and cost optimization. This marks the tenth consecutive year of revenue and profit growth.

The company maintains a basic dividend payout policy targeting a consolidated dividend payout ratio of 35% or higher, after securing internal reserves necessary for growth investments. Management emphasized that the earnings growth, particularly the better-than-planned profit results, warranted returning additional value to shareholders. The dividend increase to 59 yen per share reflects this commitment to continuous and stable profit distribution aligned with business performance.

The company also indicated it will continue to consider mechanical shareholder returns, including share repurchases and enhanced shareholder incentives, based on investment opportunities and business environment conditions.
